title: Brand across service environments
slide_intent: Compare identity across people and places because recognition depends on repeated cues through a journey.
strategic_value: Blue seats and signage, yellow uniform accents and crane reliefs can make separate service encounters feel related.
demonstration: A collage combines flags, a staff portrait, cabin seating, a crane relief, check-in and lounge interiors.
practical_value: Check whether environmental and human touchpoints reinforce the same visual ingredients.
